finalText:
Perfect! All tests pass now. The issue was that flat coupons (stored in USD) were being subtracted from the already-converted total, which applied the coupon at the wrong exchange rate. 

The fix converts the coupon amount to the target currency before subtraction, ensuring the discount is applied uniformly across currencies. For example, a $10 off coupon in a EUR order is now correctly applied as 9 EUR (10 × 0.9), not 10 USD.
